articles.title: Ethereum wallets holding $72 billion ETH are under threat of a future quantum attack
articles.snippet: Researchers find that accounts with visible public keys hold nearly 55% of ether outside staking, and propose a way to move them to quantum-resistant security.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles protocol security team ahead of overhaul
articles.snippet: The foundation said its next upgrade will be harder than the Merge, and the required pace of development will make it easier to ship bugs.

articles.title: Half of wallets on Trump’s dinner list got tokens from non-US exchanges
articles.snippet: Public Citizen traced 66 of 130 qualifying wallets to exchanges that restrict US users, raising questions over who is attending Trump’s memecoin dinner on Sunday.

articles.title: Google's Quantum Chip Beats Classical Limits in 'Impossible' Game
articles.snippet: Google’s Willow quantum processor beat the classical ceiling in a four-qubit coordination game, revealing a promising hardware test rather than commercial quantum computing.

articles.title: Is the AI Bubble Finally Popping? Nvidia Crashes 48% as Wall Street Experts Sound the Alarm
articles.snippet: Tech stocks are buckling after Anthropic’s historic IPO and Nvidia’s leadership crisis, while Bitcoin has slipped below $60,000. Experts disagree on whether AI faces a correction or a dot-com-style bust.
